The '''Blue Sapphire''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], a [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Genarius]]. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], [[permitor]] [[Fot Ducela]] booked rooms for [[Gender/Legends|his]] clients in this hotel, and he told them it was one of the best in the city.<ref name="Cloud Path">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths}}</ref>
